game_title: Fallback: Arithmetic Cannon – Lava River Crossing
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the fire warden must hold off magma slimes while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on magma slimes. Then check damage and advance.
player_objective: Protect the lava bridge from magma slimes in Lava River Crossing: keep damage above zero until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 2, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
